scenarios.name: Restore distinct views of one part after switching windows

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the user creates a second window for the part through View New
the first window displays the sketch in an orthogonal view
the second window displays the part in an isometric view
the user switches to the second window through Home
the second window displays its isometric view
the part's model browser is displayed
the user switches back to the first window through Home
the first window displays its orthogonal sketch view
its sketch editing environment remains active
